content.content:
Hi all,
Two changes to the October plan I sent on the 12th.
1. The Android US tablet campaign ends Sun Oct 12 and its budget moves to iOS UK, so don't make Halloween versions of anything that only runs there.
2. The Halloween flight now runs Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on the other three campaigns. Unity needs new creatives uploaded and approved before a flight starts, so every Halloween ad needs to be with me by Wed Oct 15, not the 17th.
Everything else in the plan stands.
Frederick
Hi all,
Draft plan for October so art can plan around it. Unity only: iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet, Android US phone, Android US tablet. Halloween flight Oct 20-31 on all four campaigns. Halloween creatives to me by Fri Oct 17 so I can upload them.
I'll confirm before the end of the month.
Frederick

This species is primarily nocturnal, displaying heightened activity after dusk. Known for its affinity for high-energy environments, _F. stimulatus_ often congregates in urban territories where resources are abundant. It displays strong territorial instincts and will aggressively defend perceived valuables. The species communicates using a mix of vocalizations, repetitive gestures, and distinctive postures.
*Diet:*
_F. stimulatus_ is omnivorous, though its diet is often dictated by immediate availability rather than nutritional quality. Known for its stimulant-focused cravings, it frequently seeks out rare forms of high-potency sustenance, displaying intense focus and ingenuity when foraging for stimulants.
*Adaptations:*
Among its notable adaptations, _Fractocephalus stimulatus_ exhibits remarkable endurance and resilience, often withstanding conditions that would deter less adaptive species. Its neurological pathways display a hypersensitivity to dopamine-related stimuli, driving much of its characteristic behavior.
*Reproductive Behavior:*
_F. stimulatus_ has no defined mating season and exhibits limited social bonds, often prioritizing individual survival over communal living. However, small groups may form temporarily for resource gathering.
*Conservation Status:*
Though prevalent in urban landscapes, _F. stimulatus_ faces challenges due to environmental hazards and resource competition. {"result":"{\"id\": \"page_zm3d_gdd\", \"space_id\": \"space_PROD\", \"parent_id\": \"page_prod_home\", \"title\": \"Zombie Match 3D \\u2014 Game Design Document\", \"body\": \"

This is the living Game Design Document for Zombie Match 3D (shipped on the store as Puzzles vs Zombies under Calm Play LLC until the transfer to Harmony Games and the rename on 24 July 2025). It is the source of truth for the core loop, the RPG combat layer, and monetization. For the coin/life economy see Economy Design - Coins, Lives & Boosters, and for the paid track see ZM3D Season Pass - Spec. This document ladders up to Product OKRs - 2025 H1.

ZM3D has not had a global launch. It first became publicly downloadable in the US on Google Play on April 12, 2025 and on the App Store on April 18, 2025; May 15, 2025 is the day iOS build 1.0.5 went live. This GDD reflects that build plus the Season Pass update.

Core mechanic

The matcher is a Match-3D collector benchmarked on Match Factory. Objects sit in a physics pile; the player drags items into a 7-slot tray. Collect any 3 matching objects and they clear from the tray. If all 7 slots fill without a match it counts as a blunder: the tray clears and surviving monsters enrage, but play continues. It is a tempo penalty, not a fail state - the loss screen only appears at zero health. Tray pressure is the primary difficulty dial.

  • Pile physics - objects settle and occlude each other; digging exposes buried matches.
  • 7-slot tray - the primary tempo penalty, not the fail state; tuning slot count changes felt difficulty more than object count.
  • Object families - cosmetic skins that map to elemental ammo in the RPG layer.

Zombie RPG layer

Levels wrap the matcher in combat. Each cleared triple fires the matching element at the current monster. Monsters carry an elemental weakness; hitting the weakness deals bonus damage and can apply a status.

Monster / element table

The roster is an everyday-people theme rather than classic undead. Minion families scale in tiers; bosses come in standard, Fast and Turbo variants.

{"result":"{\"id\": \"page_liveops_calendar\", \"space_id\": \"space_OPS\", \"parent_id\": \"page_ops_home\", \"title\": \"Live-Ops Event Calendar & Planning\", \"body\": \"

Owner: Frederick Stone (Growth/UA). This page is the single source of truth for what live-ops events are scheduled, on which game, and at what cadence. It pairs with the runtime that actually fires these events - for architecture, the scheduler's known fragility, and the July 2025 outage, see Live-Ops Event Engine. Event goals are set against the metrics bar tracked in Product OKRs - 2025 H1.

Event calendar

Named planning slots (a slot can ship more than once; status is the first-ship or latest planning note, not every historical run). \\\"Cadence\\\" is how the slot recurs; \\\"status\\\" is where the event stands as of the latest planning review.

EventGameCadenceStatus
Weekly QuestsDomino DelightsRecurringFailed Nov 2024 (ads-quest misdeploy)
Weekly LeaderboardsDomino Delights / Zombie Match 3DRecurringLive
Nathan's Treasure HuntDomino DelightsOne-off seasonalShipped Dec 2024
Axe ArenaDomino DelightsRecurring weekly, 2-day windows (roughly three per week)Shipped Feb 2025 — first-try / win-streak scoring; affected by the 2025 weekend scheduler outage from 15 May
Streak FeverDomino DelightsRecurring weeklyShipped Apr 2025
Win & CollectDomino DelightsRecurring weekly, in three staggered windows (Mon-Tue, Wed-Thu, Fri-Sun) that all players shareShipped Oct 2024 — Domino Delights' first live event
River RushDomino DelightsRecurring weeklyShipped Apr 2025
Plague RaceZombie Match 3DRecurringLive; algo bug Aug 2025
Zombie LaneZombie Match 3DPermanent (level-gated reward track)Live
Endless Monster ModeZombie Match 3DRecurring - daily reset 00:00 UTC, weekly reset Monday 00:00 UTCLive; also one of the three permanent board modes
Collect & WinZombie Match 3DRecurring weekly, in three staggered windows (Mon-Tue, Wed-Thu, Fri-Sun) that all players shareBuilt for the end-of-September beta submission (QA blockers cleared 26 Sep 2025); not yet live. Same feature as Win & Collect on Domino Delights, under a different name

Notes on individual events

  • Nathan's Treasure Hunt - our best-performing GoD seasonal to date; the reward-ladder structure is the template we now reuse for one-off events.
  • Plague Race - the recurring ranked competition on ZM3D. In Aug 2025 the algorithmically generated levels - everything above level 100 - did not count toward the race, so high-level players could not score (ZOM-459, opened 5 Aug, fixed 25 Aug 2025). It affected scoring for players above level 100, so pre-fix placements and reward settlement in those races are unreliable — at least one player who was leading lost and had to be compensated by hand. It did not affect revenue; Plague Race carries no IAP.
  • Endless Monster Mode - a permanent ZM3D board mode, not a seasonal event. It unlocks at level 24 and resets daily at 00:00 UTC and weekly on Monday 00:00 UTC, both cron-scheduled in the CDK stack. ZOM-297 was closed on 1 Aug 2025, but that is the ticket close, not the ship: the mode reached players in the release submitted 6 Aug — Android 0.3.99 on 6 Aug, iOS 0.3.11 on 7 Aug 2025.

2025 weekend live-ops outage. Domino Delights' weekend events failed to activate, so the published calendar diverged from what players actually saw. QA first reported it on Sunday 29 June 2025 and the events were enabled by hand in the database that day; it recurred unfixed and was reported again on Saturday 12 July. The cause was a scheduler bug — the generator runs Sunday 00:00 UTC and set the Saturday–Sunday block to end on that same Sunday, six days before its own start, so the block never activated. Streak Fever was affected from 1 April and Axe Arena from 15 May. A one-line fix was committed on 19 July 2025. The record contains no deployment of that fix and no message confirming the calendar was healthy again, so this outage has no recorded end — do not quote a duration. The lives/energy problem reported in the same thread is a SEPARATE, client-side issue with its own open tickets; it is not part of this outage. Do not backfill or reason about that window from this calendar - the Live-Ops Event Engine page holds the reconstructed timeline and how to measure the outage.

Planning cadence

We are a small studio, so live-ops planning is deliberately lightweight - one recurring meeting and one shared calendar, not a dedicated ops team. The working rhythm:

  • Daily live-ops pod review. Design, led by Julia Lawson, walks the coming weeks with Frederick Stone: which recurring slots fire and whether a one-off drops on top. Company-wide sync is the Friday all-hands.
  • There is no technical content lock. Reward tables are re-imported from Google Sheets hourly in production (IMPORT_REWARDS_SCHEDULE defaults to 0 * * * *), so a mid-window sheet edit reaches players within the hour. The 24h season-pass freeze in the Season Pass spec is a process control on top of that, not a mechanism. Windows are cron expressions in the CDK stack and do need a deploy to change.
  • Overlapping events are normal. Domino Delights runs four weekly events concurrently in production, and Zombie Match 3D overlaps Plague Race, Leagues and both Endless Monster resets. Avoiding overlap has been discussed as an aspiration but is not an operating rule.
  • Post-event read. Each event gets a short retro against its target from Product OKRs before the slot is reused.

The recurring slots (Endless Monster Mode (a permanent board mode with daily and weekly resets, not a seasonal event); Plague Race ranked) are the backbone of the calendar. One-off seasonals like Nathan's Treasure Hunt are layered on for spikes - they are the exception, not the base cadence, and should never displace a recurring slot without documented Product approval.

input.title: ZM3D Halloween iPad 12.9" store screenshot set
input.description:
Halloween version of the live iPad 12.9" App Store set (live since Sep 17). The iPhone 6.5" and Google Play phone Halloween sets are already exported in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store. The iPad set is the only store screenshot set still missing.

**Direction (Robert's Seasonal art direction, Q4 2025):** keep the same comps as the live iPad set and add only the seasonal layer (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment). Same flat background, same pose, same zombie order, same CTA. Match the iPhone 6.5" Halloween set.

**Due:** Wed Oct 15, exported to ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store. Hard cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT: iOS screenshots can only change with a new version, so this set goes up with the Oct 17 submission. Live from about Wed Oct 22 after Apple review. It reverts to normal with the Nov 6 submission.

Plan + tracker: see Claire's ZM3D Halloween plan doc / tracker (linked in #zombie_marketing).

input.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
input.bodyText:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For the Thu Oct 2 Halloween review. Please comment directly in this doc.
Tracker (every item, call, owner and due date): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit

1. Goal
Leonard wants everything players see from us to look like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live today (Oct 1), the Halloween call for each piece, who makes it, and by when.

2. What's live today
Store: app icon, iPhone 6.5" set and iPad 12.9" set (App Store), and the Google Play phone set. All live since Sep 17.
Ads: 58 Unity creatives across iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet, Android US phone and Android US tablet. That's the 56 on the ZM3D live creatives sheet plus two that are running but missing from the sheet:
- ART-826 julia 4:5 static ("They're coming, stop them!"): still on iOS UK and still our best CPI there (Frederick's comment on the ZM roadmap Halloween card).
- ART-831 Marcus's portrait UA end card: plays after every Android US phone video (Frederick, checked Sep 29).
Frederick, can we add both to the sheet?

3. Inputs and the rules they set
- Frederick's Sep 30 UA changes: Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12 and its budget moves to iOS UK, so no Halloween versions of anything that only runs there. The Halloween flight is Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 so Unity can approve it before the flight. This replaces the Oct 17 date in his Sep 12 draft.
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween. The merge cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. New iOS screenshots (and the icon, which ships in the build) must be in by then. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so plan on the iOS build and listing being live from about Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics aren't tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review. The Nov 6 submission puts the icon and screenshots back to normal.
- Robert's Seasonal art direction (Q4 2025): seasonal dressing only goes on top of current art. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture counts. A video whose master has music baked in is re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); background, pose, zombie order and CTA stay the same so each variant tests clean against its normal version.
- Calls (from Robert's deck): Halloween version = dress it from the current art. Refresh first = re-capture, re-render or re-cut, then the Halloween pass. Reuse = a Halloween version already exists. Skip = no Halloween version this time.
- Who makes what (Leonard): Martin does the icon and stills (store screenshots and Julia's statics). Marcus does video and end cards.
- Store tickets (Leonard, #zombie-art Sep 30): store art that's already exported is done and needs no ticket. Tickets are only for store art that still has to be made.

4. Store pages
- App icon: Halloween version, Martin, new ticket ART-856. The Sep 17 draft was too busy at icon size, and Robert wants it as simple as the current icon. Due Wed Oct 15 to Arthur; the hard cut is the Oct 16 12:00 PT merge.
  On swapping the icon around the 24th: on iOS the icon is part of the build, so the only Halloween window is the Oct 17 submission, live about Oct 22. It can't change on Oct 24 by itself. Proposal: upload the Google Play icon Tue Oct 21 so both stores switch on Oct 22. Both revert with the Nov 6 submission.
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse. Martin's Halloween set (5 screens) is already in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store and goes up with the Oct 17 submission. Live about Oct 22.
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version, Martin, new ticket ART-855. No Halloween iPad set exists yet. Due Wed Oct 15; hard cut Oct 16 12:00 PT.
- Google Play phone set: Reuse. Martin's Halloween set (6 screens) is already exported. Upload Fri Oct 17 so it's live Sat Oct 18 with the flight.

5. Ads (58)
Summary: 14 Halloween versions, 34 refresh first, 2 reuse, 8 skip. Every ad call and due date is also commented on its ART ticket, and every ad that needs new work is assigned to its maker.
Due dates: refresh-first work by Wed Oct 8, so the Halloween pass still has a week. Every Halloween ad to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.

Reuse (2), ready now:
- ART-808 cheer fastcouch 9:16 and ART-816 cheer fastcouch 16:9: Marcus's Halloween cuts from the no-music masters are already in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / UA masters. Frederick can queue them now.

Halloween version (14). All current captures (Android #1529 or later) with no-music masters:
- Marcus: ART-795 couch alpha 50, ART-797 balloons alpha 50 (1), ART-805 barrel marketing2 4:5, ART-817 / 818 / 819 marcus.bennett 16:9, 4:5, 1:1, ART-833 / 834 / 835 / 848 end card 001 (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5), ART-851 cheer fastcouch 4:5, ART-852 barrel marketing2 1:1, ART-853 couch alpha 50 4:5, ART-854 balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9.

Refresh first (34):
- Marcus, pre-#1452 captures: ART-793 couch boss 30, ART-794 couch alpha 30, ART-800 / 801 / 803 / 804 9:16 endcard cuts, ART-810 / 811 squirrelfail, ART-812 / 813 mrfluffernot, ART-814 / 815 / 845 / 846 cinematic tutorials (all prototype captures from Dec 2024), ART-823 couch alpha 50 16:9 (re-export from the Sep 22 #1935 re-capture), ART-831 portrait UA end card (rendered from #1450, two builds before the swap), ART-832 end card template 16:9, ART-840 boris fastcouch 9:16 (gameplay captured Jul 28), ART-841 / 850 boris alin2, ART-843 couch boss 30 16:9.
- Marcus, pre-#1452 AND music baked into the master (re-capture and cut a no-music master): ART-796 balloons alpha 50, ART-798 barrel alpha 30, ART-799 couch marketing2 30s, ART-802 couch alpha 30 endcard, ART-807 cheer 30p 9:16, ART-847 cheer 30p 4:5.
- Marcus, current capture but music baked in: ART-809 marcus.bennett 9:16. Re-cut it from his Aug 13 no-music export (InvestorFacing_Seq3_NoMusic).
- Martin, Julia's statics, all made from Android #852 captures (Jun 5): ART-825 julia 1:1, ART-826 julia 4:5 (best iOS UK CPI, so prioritise it), ART-827 julia 9:16, ART-828 julia 16:9, ART-829 julia 1:1 android 1080, ART-830 julia 4:5 android 1080x1350.

Skip (8). They only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12:
- ART-806 barrel marketing2 16:9, ART-820 cheer 30p 16:9, ART-821 couch alpha 30 16:9, ART-822 balloons alpha 50 16:9, ART-824 barrel alpha 30 endcard 16:9, ART-842 boris fastcouch 16:9, ART-844 couch marketing2 30s 16:9, ART-849 julia 1:1 android tablet.

6. Who makes what, by when
- Marcus Bennett: 28 refresh-first by Wed Oct 8, then 42 Halloween ads (28 refreshed + 14 straight Halloween) to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Martin Walsh: 6 Julia statics refreshed by Wed Oct 8 and Halloween to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. Icon (ART-856) and iPad set (ART-855) by Wed Oct 15.
- Frederick Stone: queue the Halloween uploads as they land (the 2 reuse cuts are ready now). Flight Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31.
- Arthur Blake: icon and iPhone + iPad Halloween screenshots in the Oct 17 submission (merge cut Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT). Normal art back in the Nov 6 submission.
- Store uploads: Google Play screenshots on Fri Oct 17, Google Play icon on Tue Oct 21, swapped back for the Nov 6 clean-up. Leonard, who owns these uploads?

7. Risks and open questions
- Marcus's load: 42 ads, 28 of them re-captures first. If that's too much by Oct 15, we can drop the weakest refresh-first ads to Skip rather than put a stale build in a Halloween ad. Frederick, can you rank the refresh-first ads by spend?
- The icon has the least slack: Robert has to sign off on a simpler comp, and engineering has to merge it before noon PT Oct 16.
- The live creatives sheet is missing ART-826 and ART-831. Both are in this plan.
- Halloween props: the Halloween pack we already use (pumpkins, fog) covers the dressing, so we don't need the outside props bundle that was pitched to me.

python3 -c "
import json
rows=json.load(open('rows.json'))
P='Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/37dbe022571a2be12f93ffe1/edit · Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit'
for r in rows:
  c=r['code']
  if c=='S':
    t=f\"Halloween call: **Skip**. It {r['why']}, so there's no Halloween version (Frederick's Sep 30 UA change). No art work needed.\"
  elif c=='U':
    t=f\"Halloween call: **Reuse**. {r['why']}. Due: with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (ready now) for the Halloween flight Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on {r['camps']}.\"
  elif c=='H':
    t=f\"Halloween call: **Halloween version**. {r['why'][0].upper()+r['why'][1:]}. Add only the seasonal layer (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); background, pose, zombie order and CTA stay the same. Maker: {r['owner']}. Due: to Frederick by **Wed Oct 15** for the Halloween flight Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on {r['camps']}.\"
  else:
    t=f\"Halloween call: **Refresh first**. {r['why'][0].upper()+r['why'][1:]}. Maker: {r['owner']}. Due: refresh on the current build by **Wed Oct 8**, then the Halloween pass (seasonal layer only) to Frederick by **Wed Oct 15** for the flight Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on {r['camps']}.\"
  r['comment']=t+'\n\n'+P
json.dump(rows,open('rows.json','w'),indent=1)
print(rows[0]['comment']);print(rows[13]['comment']);print(rows[15]['comment']);print(rows[2]['comment'])
"

content.content: {"result":"{\"id\": \"ART-856\", \"uuid\": null, \"identifier\": \"ART-856\", \"number\": 856, \"title\": \"ZM3D Halloween app icon (simple version, App Store + Google Play)\", \"description\": \"Halloween version of the live app icon (live on both stores since Sep 17).\\n\\n**Direction:** On Sep 17 in #zombie-art, Robert said the Sep 17 AppIconHalloween draft gets too busy at icon size, and a Halloween icon should stay as simple as the current one. Keep the current icon and add one light seasonal touch, per the Seasonal art direction deck. Get Robert's OK on the comp first.\\n\\n**Due:** Wed Oct 15, final assets handed to Arthur for the build. Halloween art plan and tracker are ready for Thursday's review. Both are shared with everyone on the invite so you can comment:
• Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/37dbe022571a2be12f93ffe1/edit
• Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit

• **Ads (58 live):** 14 get a Halloween version, 34 need a refresh first (pre-#1452 captures or music baked into the master), 2 reuse Marcus's existing cheer fastcouch Halloween cuts, and 8 are skipped because they only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12. Every ART ticket has its call and due date in a comment. The 48 that need work are assigned to Marcus (videos and end cards) or Martin (Julia's statics). Refreshes are due Wed Oct 8, and every Halloween ad goes to Frederick by Wed Oct 15 for the Oct 18-31 flight.
• **Two ads missing from the live sheet:** julia 4:5 (ART-826, our best iOS UK CPI) and Marcus's portrait end card (ART-831). Both are in the plan.
• **Store:** the iPhone and Google Play Halloween sets are already exported (reuse). New tickets: <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-855|ART-855> for the iPad 12.9" set and <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-856|ART-856> for a simpler icon, both Martin, due Oct 15.
• **Icon timing:** we can't swap it on the 24th by itself, because on iOS the icon ships in the build. Its only window is the Oct 17 submission (merge cut Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT), live around Oct 22. Proposal: upload the Google Play icon Oct 21 so both stores switch on Oct 22, and revert with the Nov 6 submission.

content.text:
The plan doc and tracker are in your Drive, shared with all six people on Thursday's review (Leonard, Frederick, Martin, Marcus, Robert, Arthur) with comment access, and both links are posted in Leonard's thread.

- **Plan:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/37dbe022571a2be12f93ffe1/edit
- **Tracker** (tabs for store, ads and key dates): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit
- **Slack reply:** https://harmonygamesgroup.slack.com/archives/C06DJBJL798/p1759302639000000?thread_ts=1759269913.882683&cid=C06DJBJL798

**How the calls were made**
- **Robert's deck:** anything captured before the Jul 29 zombie swap (Android #1452), or with music baked into the video, gets refreshed first. Anything that already has a Halloween version gets reused.
- **Frederick's Sep 30 email:** the Android US tablet campaign ends Oct 12, so ads that only run there are skipped. The Halloween flight is Oct 18–31, and every Halloween ad has to reach him by Wed Oct 15.
- **Arthur's calendar:** the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween. Its merge cut is Thu Oct 16 at 12:00 PT, and it should be live around Oct 22 after Apple review.

**Ads: 58 live, not 56.** Two ads that are running are missing from the live creatives sheet: Julia's 4:5 static (ART-826, still the best iOS UK CPI per Frederick) and Marcus's portrait end card (ART-831). I've included both.

| Call | Count | Who | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| Halloween version | 14 | Marcus | Wed Oct 15 |
| Refresh first, then Halloween | 34 | Marcus 28, Martin 6 (Julia's statics) | Refresh Wed Oct 8, Halloween Wed Oct 15 |
| Reuse Marcus's existing cheer fastcouch Halloween cuts | 2 | — | Ready now |
| Skip (Android US tablet only) | 8 | — | — |

All 58 ART tickets have a comment with the call, reason and due date. The 48 that need work are assigned, due Oct 15, and moved from Done to Todo. You didn't ask for the status change, but otherwise they'd sit as Done while assigned.

**Store**
- The iPhone and Google Play Halloween screenshot sets are already exported, so they're reuse with no tickets, as Leonard asked.
- I opened two tickets for Martin, both due Oct 15: **ART-855** for the iPad 12.9" set and **ART-856** for a simpler icon. Robert said Martin's Sep 17 icon draft was too busy at that size.

**For Thursday**
- **Icon on the 24th:** that doesn't work. On iOS the icon ships inside the app build, so it can only change with the Oct 17 submission. My proposal is to upload the Google Play icon Oct 21 so both stores switch Oct 22, then revert everything with the Nov 6 submission.
- **Marcus's load:** he has 42 ads, 28 of them refresh-first. In the plan I've asked Frederick to rank the refresh items by spend, so the weakest can be dropped to skip if needed.
- **Google Play uploads:** I don't know who uploads the screenshots (Oct 17) and icon (Oct 21). That's flagged as an open question for Leonard.
- **Props vendor:** I didn't reply to the outside vendor pitching a $39 Halloween props bundle (reply-by Oct 3). The plan notes we don't need it because our existing Halloween pack covers the dressing.
